I plotted monthly revenue from `data/sales.csv` as a bar chart and saved it to:

`/Users/reader/probe-822.z90ipi/runs/claude/sonnet+note/make-where-in/acme-dashboard/output/monthly_revenue.png`

It has one bar per month, Jan to Dec 2026, on a $0 baseline. Revenue rises from $41,200 in January to $71,800 in December, with small dips in February, June and October. I labelled the first and last bars, and the peak is also December, so it needed no separate label.

I wrote the plotting script to `/tmp/plot/plot.py`, outside the repo, so the repo only gains the new `output/` folder. I didn't run the dataviz skill's palette validator, because the chart is a single series in one blue.
